summary: Playing the known castle passtune reaches dbridge.c:open_drawbridge. C runs do_entity() for bridge occupants; e_missed() consumes rnd(8), then the bridge crushes or relocates occupants. JavaScript do_play_instrument() records the unported open_drawbridge call and skips these effects, so the screen, RNG, and later steps diverge.

source.branch: The hero plays the saved passtune on the Stronghold level while a drawbridge is raised, and an entity occupies its bridge or portcullis square; open_drawbridge() lowers the bridge and do_entity() resolves that occupant.
callers: music.c:do_play_instrument() calls close_drawbridge() or open_drawbridge() after the saved Stronghold passtune matches; the v58 replay exercises open_drawbridge().
detect.c:openone() calls open_drawbridge() for a raised drawbridge found by do_clear_area(); the independent blessed Bell recording exercises this path.
zap.c:zap_updown() calls open_drawbridge() and close_drawbridge() for up/down wands at a portcullis; A2 currently reserves this exact caller, so its wiring is deferred until the reservation clears.
zap.c:zap_map() handles lateral opening/locking effects; its production caller is zap.c:bhit(). The independent lateral zap recording exercises close_drawbridge() through bhit() and zap_map().
dependencies: revive_nasty() return values are discarded; record this gap and skip the calls as required.
e_died() invokes hero drown/lava/done/teleds and monster xkilled/monkilled; preserve those state changes.
do_entity() relocation uses remove_monster/place_monster/update_monster_region and recursively handles occupant conflicts.
